products.name: Treated Pine Paling Fence
products.description: Generic treated pine paling fence. H4 posts (100x75mm or 100x100mm) set in concrete 600mm deep, H3 75x38mm rails (2 rails up to 1350mm height, 3 above), H3 palings 100x16mm or 150x16mm cut at fence height in butted, lapped, or lapped-and-capped styles. Optional 150x25mm H4 plinth (kickboard). Timber is sourced from local merchants — SKUs are generic; prices to be filled in by the owner.

metadata.notes: maxPanelWidth 2400 = max post spacing 2400mm centres. Post length = height + 600mm embedment, rounded up to stock (1800/2100/2400/2700/3000mm). Paling stock lengths 900/1200/1500/1800/2100/2400mm.

rule_sets.name: TP Paling Fence Rules
rule_sets.description: Data-driven Treated Pine paling fence BOM rules v3

rule_versions.notes: Initial TP paling rules from owner quote specs. Lap overlap, rail thresholds and nail counts flagged for owner confirmation.

product_constraints.name: max_panel_width_mm
product_constraints.message: Post spacing above 2400mm centres is not supported for paling fences; split into additional panels.

product_constraints.name: allowed_height_mm
product_constraints.message: Standard paling fence heights are 1200/1500/1800/2100mm. Other heights need stock-length checks.

product_variables.label: Paling Style

product_validations.message: Height is outside the standard paling set (1200/1500/1800/2100mm) — check paling and post stock lengths.

product_rules.name: rail_rows
product_rules.notes: 2 rails for heights <= 1350mm, 3 rails above. Owner to confirm threshold for their build style.

product_rules.name: post_length_required_mm
product_rules.notes: Post length = fence height + 600mm concrete embedment.

product_rules.name: post_stock_length_mm
product_rules.notes: Round required post length UP to nearest stock length (1800/2100/2400/2700/3000mm).

product_rules.name: paling_stock_length_mm
product_rules.notes: Paling length = fence height, rounded up to nearest paling stock length (900/1200/1500/1800/2100/2400mm).

product_rules.name: num_palings
product_rules.notes: ASSUMPTION for owner to confirm: butted = ceil(run/paling_width)+1 (side by side, +1 closer). Lapped and lapped-capped = ceil(run/(paling_width - 25))+1 — each paling overlaps its neighbour by 25mm, so effective coverage per paling is width-25. Correct the 25mm overlap here if the crew laps differently.

product_rules.name: rail_stocks
product_rules.notes: Rails are continuous per rail-row along the run; 4800mm stock. Per-row ceil so joins land on posts (4800 = 2 x 2400 max bays). stocks() helper not used because it under-counts when a continuous run exceeds one stock length.

product_rules.name: capping_stocks
product_rules.notes: 75x38 H3 capping along the entire run for lapped-capped style only; 4800mm stock.

product_rules.name: plinth_stocks
product_rules.notes: Optional single 150x25 H4 plinth row along the run; 4800mm stock.

product_rules.name: concrete_bags
product_rules.notes: 2 x 20kg rapid set bags per post (100x75/100x100 post in 600mm deep footing). Owner to confirm bag count.

product_rules.name: total_nails
product_rules.notes: 2 nails per paling per rail.

product_rules.name: nail_boxes
product_rules.notes: Premier Nails F45/2.5 boxes hold 7,500 nails ($78/box per Xero bills).

product_warnings.message: 2 rails for heights up to 1350mm, 3 rails over — confirm for your build style.
Lapped palings assume a 25mm overlap per paling.
Prices sourced from B&B Timbers / Premier Nails purchase history (Xero). Still unpriced: 900mm palings and all 150mm-wide palings — those lines show $0 until purchased or priced manually.
Fence height above 2100mm is non-standard for paling fences — check post and paling stock availability.
